evidence_slice: HM Revenue & Customs' official East Midlands Investment Zone tax-site publication identifies three tax sites within the East Midlands Investment Zone: Infinity Park, Hartington and Explore Park. The publication provides a dedicated map attachment titled 'Infinity Park Derby' showing the exact tax-site location. The page states that Infinity Park is about 5 miles south of Derby city centre, has access from junction 3 of the A50, and is near the M1 and East Midlands Airport. The publication was last updated on 5 August 2025.
